channel.title: Cochran Films Journal
channel.description: Field notes from Cochran Films on profit, clients, production, and the systems that let a small Atlanta studio deliver like a larger one.

item.title: You Made $10,000. Here Is What You Actually Kept.
item.description: A practical split between revenue and profit for creators: how to divide a client payment, price for margin, and put money back into the business instead of spending the invoice.

item.title: Slow Season Is a Test, Not a Verdict
item.description: How creators should use a slow season: fix the offer, protect the gear, save from the busy months, and build client relationships before the calendar fills again.

item.title: Stop Chasing New Clients. Keep the Good Ones.
item.description: Why keeping a good client beats chasing a new one, and how retainers, boundaries, and a calmer experience turn a first job into a year of work.

item.title: Stop Pouring Into People Who Will Not Pour Back
item.description: How creators decide where attention goes: mutual partnerships, hot leads, and the discipline to stop blending in and stop funding relationships that do not move.

item.title: You Cannot Want the Win More Than They Do
item.description: Why creators burn out carrying clients, leads, and collaborators who will not move, and how to stay prepared without doing someone else’s job for them.

item.title: How to Choose a Videographer in Atlanta
item.description: A buyer checklist for how to choose a videographer in Atlanta: portfolio depth, gear, delivery, communication, clear pricing, and proof of reliability.

item.title: From Douglasville to the Main Stage
item.description: Practical field lessons from One Music Fest, an iHeart podcast, and the Andre Dickens campaign on preparation, redundancy, and staying calm under pressure.

item.title: The Cochran Films Approach to Brand Storytelling
item.description: Brand storytelling video in Atlanta works when story, light, sound, and pace earn trust. Here is the practical Cochran Films approach to a brand film.

item.title: Web Development for Creative Brands
item.description: Web development for creatives in Atlanta should be fast, clear, and easy to find. See how structure, speed, and calls to action sell while you sleep tonight.

item.title: Cloud Delivery for Secure Client Footage
item.description: Secure client footage delivery is part of the experience. See how a clean Bizzi Cloud handoff protects files and makes the studio look finished and trusted.

item.title: Workflow Automation for Creative Businesses
item.description: Workflow automation for creatives saves real hours in intake, quoting, contracts, scheduling, and delivery so a small studio can ship with less daily stress.

item.title: How Creators Turn a Camera Into a Company
item.description: How to start a videography business with clearer pricing, real systems, and a legitimate company, drawn from the path that led Cody Cochran to Cochran Films.

item.title: The Sony FX6 and FX3 on Location
item.description: A practical look at the Sony FX6 and FX3 documentary setup Cochran Films uses on location, with GODOX light, DJI support, and RODE audio for real field days.

item.title: Color Grading: Raw Footage to Finished Film
item.description: Learn how color grading in video production turns raw clips into a finished film, why every clip takes real labor, and where that craft shows up on screen.

item.title: Building Systems That Scale for Creative Work
item.description: Great media opens the door. Workflow systems for creative businesses keep clients through booking, portals, and delivery a small Atlanta team can run.

item.title: Corporate Event Videography Field Guide
item.description: A field guide for conference planners covering keynotes, breakouts, two videographers in large rooms, color grading, and how deliverables should be scoped.

item.title: Podcast Production in Atlanta for Leaders
item.description: What executives should expect from podcast production in Atlanta: multi camera capture, RODE audio, lighting, editing, and a steady delivery rhythm each month.

item.title: On Site Event Printing for Brand Ambassadors
item.description: On site event printing in Atlanta puts a branded photo in a guest's hand. See how the DNP printer, Capture One, and Hot Folder Print drive real reach.

item.title: Cost of Hiring In House Versus an Agency
item.description: Salary is only the start of hiring an in house videographer in Atlanta. See payroll taxes, benefits, gear, software, and ramp up next to an agency retainer.

item.title: Why Atlanta Brands Choose a Full Stack Creative Studio
item.description: See why Atlanta brands hire one full stack studio for video, photo, podcast, print, web, and automation, and why one partner beats a pile of freelancers.
